code_or_query:
import numpy as np
I=0.002  # kg m2, 3x 40g blades R0.2m: I~3*1/3*m*R2=0.0016 + hub/gen 0.0004
w_top=3150*2*np.pi/60  # rad/s ~330
w_target=0.1*w_top
# torques: aero drive at 11 m/s ~ P/w =34.7/330=0.105 Nm, use 0.12 constant worst
T_aero=0.12
k_elec=0.00047  # N m s, gives 0.155 Nm at top speed (51W dump)
T_fric=0.40  # Nm spring disc constant
dt=0.005
t=np.arange(0,10,dt)
w=np.zeros_like(t); w[0]=w_top
for i in range(1,len(t)):
    T_e=T_aero - k_elec*w[i-1] - T_fric*np.sign(w[i-1]) if w[i-1]>0.1 else T_aero - T_fric
    # if stopped and friction holds, stay 0
    if w[i-1]<=0.1 and T_fric>T_aero:
        w[i]=0
    else:
        w[i]=max(0, w[i-1]+T_e/I*dt)
# find time below 10%
idx=np.where(w<=w_target)[0]
t_cross=t[idx[0]] if len(idx)>0 else None
print(f"w_top rpm 3150, w_target rpm {w_target*60/2/np.pi:.0f}")
print(f"t_cross {t_cross:.2f} s, w@10s rpm {w[-1]*60/2/np.pi:.1f}")
print(f"KE top J {0.5*I*w_top**2:.1f}, friction power at top W {T_fric*w_top:.0f}")
